WITH overheat_incidents AS (
  SELECT incident_id, machine_id, ts
  FROM sf_ops.incidents
  WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat'
),
incident_signal AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN t.machine_id IS NOT NULL AND (t.failure = 1 OR t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_signal
  FROM overheat_incidents i
  LEFT JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry t
    ON i.machine_id = t.machine_id
   AND date_trunc('HOUR', i.ts) = t.ts
  GROUP BY i.incident_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN has_signal = 1 THEN 'with_failure_signal' ELSE 'no_failure_signal' END AS signal_category,
  COUNT(*) AS incident_count
FROM incident_signal
GROUP BY signal_category
ORDER BY incident_count DESC
data.purpose: Count machine_overheat incidents with versus without a telemetry failure or heat_dissipation signal in the same hour
